hooks.command: jq -r ".prompt // empty" | grep -iqE "flutter|dart|\.dart|riverpod|freezed|provider|repository|viewmodel|view model|widget|screen|scaffold|routing|navigation|localization|dio|networking|architecture|\bdomain\b|uieffect|theme|theming|colou?r|material ?3|\bm3\b|typograph|iconograph|component" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"This is Retail Shop. Before adding/modifying Dart/Flutter code or deciding where a file goes, invoke flutter-bestinet-core - it carries both the architecture rules and the M3 design system. ACTUAL stack (do not assume Clean-Architecture-with-dartz): layered MVVM under lib/modules/ (data/ presentation/ optional domain/); Riverpod @riverpod Notifier + Freezed state (@Riverpod(keepAlive:true) only for long-lived infra - session, config, storage, Dio, bootstrappers); repositories return typed DTOs/domain models via GenericApiService verb helpers (get/post/put/delete, getList/postList/...) with an explicit decoder/listDecoder; errors normalize to ApiException (NO Either/Failure/dartz, NO UseCase classes, NO Equatable entities); navigation is AppRoute + PageRouter with TWO tiers - context helpers inside the widget tree, ...Global helpers outside it (no GoRouter, no AppNavigator facade, no AppRoutes string class, no lib/core/routing); one-shot side-effects use the UiEffect framework (lib/core/utils/side_effects/ui_effect + lib/app/ui/ui_effect); M3 role-based theming is the production model - feature widgets read colours/type from context, never AppColors.x or Color(0xFF..). Keep responses focused: prefer targeted snippets over restating the whole file.\"}}" || true

jq -r ".prompt // empty" | grep -iqE "security|secure|owasp|masvs|pentest|penetration|vulnerab|breach|harden|threat|token|credential|password|biometric|keychain|keystore|encrypt|decrypt|crypto|certificate|pinning|\\btls\\b|\\bssl\\b|cleartext|permission|deep ?link|webview|obfuscat|jailbreak|\\broot(ed|ing)?\\b|screenshot|screen ?capture|backup|signing|\\bpdpa\\b|act ?854|privacy|\\bpii\\b|data ?leak" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"Security-relevant ask detected. Invoke flutter-mobile-security BEFORE changing storage, networking, auth/session, biometrics, permissions, logging, deep links or release config. It maps OWASP MASVS v2 and Mobile Top 10 (2024) onto this stack (AppStorage vs SecureAppStorage, ApiTransport/DioTransport, SessionManager, ApiException, GlobalLogger) and carries the PR-blocker list, the release gate and the quick scan. Security rules outrank convenience and outrank the architecture skill where they conflict. Findings go in this project's SECURITY_BASELINE.md, not in the skill.\"}}" || true

jq -r ".prompt // empty" | grep -iqE "readme|read ?me ?first|document|documentation|\\bdocs?\\b|notes|write ?up|write it up|handover|hand ?off|onboard|changelog|release ?notes|tester|baseline|markdown|\\bmd\\b file" && printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"UserPromptSubmit\",\"additionalContext\":\"Documentation ask detected. Invoke the readmefirst skill BEFORE creating or moving any non-code document. All non-code information lives in a single READMEFIRST/ folder at the repo root (index + notes + security baseline + tester notes + builds/), never loose markdown at the root; the root README stays a short summary that points there.
